─── Description ───
  When switching projects or first loading the UI for a project, the sidebar badge counts (inbox, observations, pending review tasks) show numbers from the previous/default project rather than the active one. They eventually correct after the 30-second refresh interval. Root cause: Sidebar.svelte loads badge counts on mount but may fire before the project context is fully resolved, or the initial API calls don't include the correct X-Kspec-Dir header for the active project. Fix: (1) ensure loadCounts() waits for the active project to be resolved before fetching, (2) reload counts immediately on project change (not just on version change), (3) consider debouncing the project switch to avoid a flash of stale counts.

fix(web-ui): gate sidebar badge counts on project store initialization

Sidebar.svelte's onMount was calling loadCounts() immediately, which
could fire before loadProjects() completed in the layout. This caused
badge counts to fetch with no X-Kspec-Dir header (or a stale one from
localStorage), showing counts from the wrong project on initial load.

Fix: Replace the eager onMount fetch with a $effect that gates on
isProjectInitialized(). Counts now load only after the project store
has resolved the active project, and reload immediately on every
project switch (via getProjectVersion() reactivity). The 30-second
polling interval is also deferred until the project store is ready.
